status: PLAN ONLY: nothing below has been downloaded. Hashes are the Hugging Face LFS SHA-256 of each file at the pinned revision, read from the Hub tree API on 2026-11-14; the download step must verify them.

sources.name: fineweb_edu
sources.license: ODC-By 1.0; use also subject to Common Crawl Terms of Use
sources.note: Smallest of the 14 sample-10BT shards. Its crawl-dump mix must be checked after download, since the shard may not be a uniform draw.

sources.name: cosmopedia_v2
sources.license: ODC-By 1.0 (smollm-corpus card); synthetic text generated by Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1 (Apache 2.0)
sources.note: Only the 'text' column is used; 'prompt' (which embeds web seed text) is dropped.

held_out_only.name: wikipedia_en
held_out_only.use: out-of-distribution bits per byte (research sample validation split only)

processing.text_normalization: none beyond UTF-8 validation; documents are joined with <|endoftext|>
processing.exact_dedup: SHA-256 of document text, within and across sources
processing.near_dedup: MinHash (word 5-gram shingles, 128 permutations, 32 bands x 4 rows, Jaccard >= 0.8), as in M3.1
processing.decontamination: drop training documents sharing a word 8-gram (lower-cased, punctuation ignored) with any evals/general_v1.json item of 8 or more words; shorter items cannot be decontaminated meaningfully and are reported only
processing.mixture: train tokens drawn 70% FineWeb-Edu / 30% Cosmopedia v2 by document order of sha256(text); each source used at most once (no repetition)
processing.tokenizer: ByteBPETokenizer, vocab 8192, DEFAULT_PATTERN, special tokens [<|endoftext|>, <|user|>, <|assistant|>, <|system|>, <|end|>], fitted on the first 100 MB (sha256 order) of the TRAIN split of the mixture only; fingerprint recorded in the manifest at preparation time
processing.storage: uint16 token streams (train.bin, val.bin, holdout.bin) with SHA-256, token counts and the tokenizer fingerprint in meta.json, as in M3.1
